article.title: Drawing from Rosa Luxemburg’s enduring legacy to move beyond protest politics
article.author: Paul Le Blanc
article.content: So far, Verso has published in English about one-fifth of what over the next two decades may add up to twenty volumes of "The Complete Works of Rosa Luxemburg". The post Drawing from Rosa Luxemburg’s enduring legacy to move beyond protest politics appeared first on MR Online .
